content.short: Yuzu Money provides institutional tokenized RWA and DeFi yield infrastructure on Monad.
content.description: Yuzu Money runs tokenized real-world asset and DeFi yield products aimed at institutional allocators, structured as several distinct product lines rather than a single pooled vault. Keeping strategies separated is largely a compliance consideration: institutions are usually constrained on what they may hold, so a blended product is often unusable to them regardless of its returns.
